verdict.rationale: The open Agent Skills specification at agentskills.io defines the SKILL.md format (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown), a `skills-ref validate` tool, and cross-product reuse. The skills CLI scaffolds SKILL.md templates and installs the same skill folders into dozens of agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more). However, no item states that skills.sh explicitly conforms to or validates against that spec, so conformance is only implied. missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that skills.sh/CLI adheres to the Agent Skills specification, spec validation built into the skills CLI or init template, independent hands-on corroboration that a skills.sh skill folder validates and works unmodified outside this tooling.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling

citations.quote: Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent.
The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
